coordinateOrder: fraction of actual inherited H above y0
normalRule: Apply inverse transpose diag(1/s,1/H,1/s) and normalize, or derive world triangle normals. Stored normal belongs to x/h/z coordinates.
triangulationRule: Explicit independently prescribed geometric partition; orientedTriangles are outward. Every face is planar. Concave end facades are separately triangulated without fan or hull fill.
decorationRule: D contains only declared upward ground paving at .004H. All structural roofs and walls are W/O.
